messages:
Asha Patel: Heads up — for next week's SI bootcamp we need a clear wiring for mentor lab access: voucher redemption flow (cloud marketplace), HW shipping/logistics, and lab creds provisioning. Can we confirm owners? TL;DR: vouchers -> marketplace entitlements -> lab creds email -> mentor role mapping.

Miguel Torres: I'm in. Quick Q — do vouchers need to be marketplace entitlements (org-scoped) or are one-off license codes fine?

Sam Wu: For DX, entitlements tied to org IDs are cleaner. One-off codes work for pilots but we lose traceability. We can support both flows but prefer org entitlements for the main cohort.

Priya Rao: Ops can automate org-entitlement provisioning. We need a canonical list of partner org IDs + expected mentor counts + shipping windows for HW. Also need a sample creds email/template to standardize.

Miguel Torres: I'll gather the entitlement list. Regarding HW: who is the vendor again? @Asha can you share contact + SLA?

Asha Patel: Vendor is EdgeForge (hw partner). Contact: lina@edgeforge.io, dropship SLA 7-10 business days. I'll ping her and ask for earlier options for mentor kits. We're planning a canary cohort of 10 mentors to test staging next Wed.

Kenji Bot: deploy-bot: Staging lab env will be updated on 2024-04-01 03:00 UTC. Maintenance window: 30m.

Sam Wu: OK — I'll draft the runbook, an enrollment form (Google form), and the email templates. Will include code snippets for CSV uploads to the provisioning pipeline.

Priya Rao: Action list for clarity:
- Miguel: entitlement CSV (org_id, partner_name, mentor_count, contact) by Tue EOD.
- Asha: share vendor contact + expedited shipping options by Tue.
- Sam: runbook + email templates by Thu morning.
- Priya: automation script for one-time credential creation and audit retained.

Miguel Torres: Ack. I'll also provide a sample CSV format: org_id,partner_name,voucher_code,mentor_email,hw_serial_expected. Will attach example in my update.

Asha Patel: Also add a rollback/fallback plan: if HW delayed, mentors must be able to join cloud-only labs (no local device). Add that to runbook and the mentor FAQ.

Sam Wu: Will do. I'll include a failover section and a short troubleshooting checklist. Draft creds email below (will mock in doc):

````
Subject: Redwood SI Mentor Lab Access
Hi <name>,
You've been provisioned as a mentor for the Redwood SI bootcamp.
Access: https://labs.redwood.ai
Login: <email>
Temporary password: <token>
Please reset within 24h.
If you need hardware support, reply to this thread or contact hw-support@redwood.ai.
Thanks!
````

Priya Rao: Ops note — we'll issue ephemeral tokens with TTL=48h for mentor sessions and rotate creds after each cohort. All provisioning actions will be logged to the audit bucket.

Asha Patel: Great. Let's do a quick sync tomorrow 9am PT (15:00 UTC). @Sam please post the runbook draft before the meeting so we can review.

Miguel Torres: :thumbsup:

Sam Wu: Will post draft by EOD today and add a link to the Google form in the doc.

Priya Rao: I'll prepare the automation playbook and test it with the canary cohort.

Asha Patel: Thanks team — this should keep onboarding smooth. I'll follow up with EdgeForge and drop the vendor reply into this thread. :package:
